description: This is a Java source file containing integration tests for the Eclipse Hono project. The tests focus on verifying AMQP command and control message handling, including sending commands, receiving responses, handling malformed messages, and rejection scenarios. It defines test classes, test methods, setups, and utility functions specific to testing the AMQP command and control functionalities within the project.

classes.name: CommandAndControlAmqpIT
classes.description: An integration test class for testing command and control messaging over AMQP in Eclipse Hono, including various scenarios such as successful command sending, malformed messages, and command rejection.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test state before each test, generating random tenant and device IDs.

methods.name: createEventConsumer
methods.description: Creates an event consumer for processing messages from the AMQP adapter.

methods.name: subscribeToCommands
methods.description: Subscribes to command messages for a given device and handles incoming messages.

methods.name: connectAndSubscribe
methods.description: Establishes connection to the AMQP adapter and subscribes to command and notification channels.

methods.name: createCommandConsumer
methods.description: Creates a handler function to process incoming command messages and send responses.

methods.name: createRejectingCommandConsumer
methods.description: Creates a handler function that rejects incoming command messages.

methods.name: testSendOneWayCommandSucceeds
methods.description: Verifies that one-way commands are successfully sent and received.

methods.name: testSendAsyncCommandsSucceeds
methods.description: Tests asynchronous command sending and response handling between application and device.

methods.name: testSendCommandSucceeds
methods.description: Verifies command request-response flow with the device.

methods.name: testSendCommandFailsForMalformedMessage
methods.description: Ensures the system gracefully handles malformed command messages.

methods.name: testSendCommandFailsForCommandRejectedByDevice
methods.description: Checks that rejection responses from devices are correctly propagated back to the application.

methods.name: connectToAdapter
methods.description: Establishes a connection to the AMQP adapter with device credentials and optional message consumer.
